source_contract.source: official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT daily aggTrades archives
source_contract.gap_policy: quarantine verified aggregate-ID-gap UTC days, the SMCC-specific duplicate-underlying-ID UTC day, missing buckets, and the following 24 five-minute bars; never impute

2020-01-15.reason: two adjacent aggregate rows repeat the same underlying trade ID and identical economic event fields; quarantine full UTC day

source_contract.zero-volume_empty_bars: only timestamps explicitly recorded by the hash-bound audit as zero volume and zero trades are complete empty bars

causal_feature_contract.group: exact equality of integer aggTrade transact_time
causal_feature_contract.group_selection: maximum group quote notional; earliest millisecond wins exact ties
causal_feature_contract.predecessor: last price of the strictly preceding millisecond group inside t; first group receives zero sweep and score
causal_feature_contract.coherence: abs(group signed quote notional) / group quote notional
causal_feature_contract.sweep_bp: 10000 * side * log(group last price / causal predecessor price)
causal_feature_contract.eligibility: bar aggTrades >=64; selected group events >=3; coherence >=0.80; nonzero side; positive sweep; score >= strictly-prior q99.5
causal_feature_contract.baseline: prior 8640 clean bars excluding t, minimum 2016 observations

execution_contract.decision: after completed bar t and source finality
execution_contract.entry: t+2 open after one full empty computation bar
execution_contract.exit: scheduled open after 144 held five-minute bars
execution_contract.funding: exact realized BTCUSDT funding under conservative boundaries
execution_contract.cagr_clock: full wall-clock split including warmup and idle cash
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM through entry cost, favorable-before-adverse held OHLC, funding, virtual adverse exit cost, and actual exit

support_schedule_contract.nonoverlap: accept when entry_position >= prior accepted exit_position; entry=t+2 and exit=entry+144
support_schedule_contract.boundary: entry and exit must both be strictly before 2024-01-01
support_schedule_contract.annual_attribution: UTC calendar year and month of entry_time
support_schedule_contract.future_source_rule: source completeness after decision t never cancels an event; only t and its strictly-prior baseline must be clean

novelty_gates.matching_algorithm: within each member coverage, sort unique UTC entries; visit primary entries chronologically and match the unused comparator entry with minimum absolute distance, breaking ties toward the earlier comparator; exact uses zero distance and tolerant uses <=12 five-minute bars

explicit_exclusions.LVRT: only one confirmed event and no canonical standalone clock
explicit_exclusions.MINUTE_PACKET_TOPOLOGY: support artifact has no canonical event clock
explicit_exclusions.NETF: no canonical clock artifact exists; RIFT is the frozen topology comparator

support_evaluator_contract.source_access_seal_rule: support execution is disabled until a hash-only seal binds the built source and manifest; populating frozen hash constants is the only permitted post-build evaluator edit
support_evaluator_contract.rolling_threshold: source score is masked to source_complete, shifted one calendar row, then rolling(window=8640,min_periods=2016).quantile(0.995); invalid rows consume clock time but do not contribute an observation
support_evaluator_contract.comparator_timestamp_semantics: registered columns ending in Z retain their offset; timezone-naive canonical comparator timestamps are interpreted as UTC because every registered artifact declares a UTC event clock
support_evaluator_contract.bafr_reporting: exact-entry Jaccard and exact primary containment only

falsification_controls.exact_side_flip: primary entry/exit clock with side multiplied by -1
falsification_controls.five_minute_return_tail_continuation: own q99.5 prior-only clock of abs(log(last_price/first_price)); side=sign(log return); same clean history, delay, hold, nonoverlap
falsification_controls.bar_notional_tail_continuation: bar_score=(quote_notional/prior-8640 median quote_notional) * max(10000*sign(signed_quote_notional)*log(last_price/first_price),0); own prior-only q99.5 clock, side=sign(signed_quote_notional), same scheduler
falsification_controls.interarrival_hhi_proxy_continuation: proxy_score=event_notional_hhi*max(interarrival_burstiness,0)*max(10000*signed_price_response,0); own prior-only q99.5 clock, side=sign(signed_quote_notional), same scheduler
falsification_controls.stale_one_hour: primary signal, side, entry, and exit shifted +12 bars
falsification_controls.stale_twenty_four_hours: primary signal, side, entry, and exit shifted +288 bars
falsification_controls.remove_coherence: selected maximum-notional ms group; score=share*max(sweep_bp,0); no coherence gate; own prior-only q99.5 clock
falsification_controls.remove_positive_sweep: selected maximum-notional ms group; score=share*coherence; no sweep sign gate; own prior-only q99.5 clock
falsification_controls.remove_collision_count: primary score and gates except selected-group event count may be one; own prior-only q99.5 clock
falsification_controls.qualification_rule: every direct control uses identical costs/accounting/stage gates; an independently qualifying direct control rejects the mechanism

claim_boundary.claim: a rare coherent exact-millisecond displacement may continue as slower inventory and risk processes react

rejection_contract: any source, support, novelty, train, or sequential-stage failure retires SMCC-144 without changing its sign, quantile, collision floor, coherence, delay, hold, costs, or gates
